source_title: Dhanush follows Vijay’s footsteps as 'OM' actor's political entry buzz grows
source_excerpt: Dhanush has been making headlines due to speculation about the actor entering the political scene. This is because of his recent involvement in welfare schemes that resemble the path adopted by the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, who went from films to politics. The actor has even taken steps to restructure his fan club and plans to create free tutoring centers in Tamil Nadu.
